reason: The cited evidence describes either rapid heating/cooling without a dwell (E3, E4) or a single-source precursor decomposition at moderate temperatures (E1, E2), but none of the passages provide specific prior evidence for the claimed effects of an intermediate thermal dwell on pre-nucleation clusters, simultaneous nucleation, or single-phase formation in noble metal HEAs. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited literature.
